result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by giving Licensee a 30-day written-notice convenience termination right, requiring repayment of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and imposing no early-termination charge. Licensor receives no convenience termination right during the committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” goes beyond the playbook, which calls only for termination of the Agreement, and could materially alter the commercial scope by permitting selective service termination. Apart from that unnecessary expansion, the added language is professionally drafted.
